frames.title: isorite in the terminal
frames.text: OpenCode, with your knowledge base beside it. This tour uses an example base on DMFT and a scripted model: nothing is sent anywhere. Press enter to open.

frames.title: Ask about your notes
frames.text: The prompt is filled in. Press enter, and watch the agent look your notes up: by words, by meaning, and along their links.

frames.title: Notes in play
frames.text: On the right: what it found, what it reached from there, and what it used, in gold. Its answer cites your notes, [1] and its section. Type /next.

frames.title: One note's atlas
frames.text: Type /atlas the dmft loop. Beside the chat: what the note requires, on the left, and what builds on it, on the right. In the browser, the whole map follows the agent.

frames.title: Changes to notes wait
frames.text: Ask it to change your notes. Edits to code are OpenCode's, and it asks before it writes a file: allow it. Edits to notes wait for you to keep them.
frames.does: press enter, and allow the write

frames.title: Open the note
frames.text: Type /note the dmft loop. A note in the terminal: who wrote each paragraph in the gutter, maths as source, links underlined.

frames.title: Keep it, or not
frames.text: The agent's change waits between dotted lines. [k] keeps it, [e] edits it first, [r] removes it; [n] goes to the next.

frames.title: Ask Iso here
frames.text: ↑ and ↓ choose a paragraph; [/] asks Iso, isorite's own agent, to write after it. Its answer waits for you the same way.

frames.title: Every change is kept
frames.text: [t] lists the note's history. Choose a moment to see the note as it was then; [q] comes back to now.

frames.title: Send it to the agent
frames.text: [s] sends the paragraph the cursor is on to the agent, with what you want of it. It waits under "from you" for your next prompt.
frames.does: press q, then s, and say what you want

frames.title: That is the terminal
frames.text: On your own base: isorite term <base>. Point it at a model with ISORITE_GATEWAY_URL, or use OpenCode's own. /tour hides this card, /next closes it.
